items.title: ARC-005 precision monotonicity, finer 7-level ladder (breaks 848a 3-point Spearman-rho ceiling)
items.note: Measurement/test-design successor of V3-EXQ-848a (same scientific question, same substrate, same calibration dacc_goal_readout_weight=0.5/normalize=True, SAME pre-registered acceptance rule |Spearman rho|>=0.60 in >=7/10 (content x seed) units, UNSIGNED). The ONLY design delta is measurement RESOLUTION: the channel-1+2 precision ladder goes 3-level [0,0.5,1.0] -> 7-level [0/6..6/6] (70 cells: 7 levels x 2 content x 5 seeds vs 30 in 848a). Routing output of confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-848a_2026-08-03 (REE_assembly 2c2268afad): 848a CLOSED the wiring/calibration line (channel genuinely engaged, 25,289 dACC bias calls) but scored 1/10 units on the 3-level ladder with a per-unit rho distribution ({+0.5 x6,+1.0 x1,-0.5 x2,0.0 x1}, 7/10 positive-signed) that is the arithmetic signature of a 3-point Spearman resolution ceiling (rho can only take {-1,-0.5,0,+0.5,+1} at n=3), NOT a clean null (802's genuinely-null channels gave bit-identical rho=0.0). At n=7 the H0 SD of rho is ~0.408 so the same 0.60 bar is a genuine signal threshold and is achievable by a consistent weak monotone trend, while a true null scatters near 0 (cleanly separable from a weak-real trend). Mann-Kendall two-sided p + Theil-Sen slope + Kendall tau recorded per unit as resolution-independent SECONDARY diagnostics (task-brief's 'magnitude-based statistic', honoured as continuous trend readouts NOT an absolute-floor gate: 848a's raw readouts show the real effect is ~1e-3 log10-units, swamped ~180x by the ~0.18 cross-seed SD, so the signal is in ORDERING CONSISTENCY and any principled magnitude floor would wrongly REJECT it). Plus a manifest-level resolution diagnostic (n_distinct_rho_values) as direct evidence the 3-point ceiling is broken. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = |rho of log10-precision vs level| over a 7-LEVEL ladder; no recorded manifest carries it (848a is 3-level, 802/846 are different manipulations) -> not recoverable, must run. Re-derive brake: 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag ARC-005 -> does not fire (this is a test-design redesign, not a re-test circling a ceiling). DV-symmetry per arm: channel-1 (5-HT/calibrated dACC goal-readout) is genuinely weighted+per-candidate-set-normalised -> NOT invariant under the log10-precision DV's additive-constant/argmax or monotone-rescale/rank symmetries (a measured trend is a real measurement); channel-2 (phasic gain) is a genuine E3 softmax temperature -> argmax-invariant under the deterministic committed selection this runs under (~97% commitment), so its contribution to rho is architecturally expected NULL (unchanged by the finer ladder); channels 3/4 held fixed at L0 (SCOPE), no DV-symmetry claim. MUST run on a cloud worker (machine_class linux-x86_64-py3.10 like 848a's ree-worker-1 run) so the multinomial-sampled selection path is machine-class-matched to 848a; machine_class recorded so a Mac-landed (darwin-arm64) run can be discarded. Governance should read 848a and 848b together (848b is the resolution-corrected measurement of the same effect); does NOT invalidate 848a. Follow-on OUT OF SCOPE (report only, not chipped here): a channel-1 sub-pathway isolation (ladder dACC-consume flags alone with serotonin fixed) to attribute a positive result to the goal-readout sub-pathway vs the pre-existing serotonin pathway. Smoke: --strict validate_experiments clean; dry-run PASS end-to-end (28 dry cells all ran, dACC engaged 1148 bias calls, build-time guards held, valid manifest emitted, no traceback; dry FAIL/clamp is the expected 40-measure-tick artifact, not scored on a smoke). Queued with --allow-overlap on experiment_queue.json: genuinely different task (different EXQ id + script) from the concurrent IGW ARC-045 queue-experiment session -- both only append to the shared queue file, not duplicated work.

items.title: MECH-322 sleep-replay carve-out: fraction-based readiness gate decoupling stochastic candidate-emergence from deterministic AND-gate minting (supersedes V3-EXQ-873)
items.note: Corrected re-test of V3-EXQ-873 (MECH-322 sleep-replay carve-out AND-gate), supersedes it per confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-873_2026-08-03 (measurement_test_design_defect, evidence_direction mixed leaning-supports). FIRST-ever experimental test of MECH-322; 873 was the only run to flip use_chunk_replay_origin_path ON. SAME QUESTION, SAME SUBSTRATE, SAME MANIPULATION -- only the cross-seed AGGREGATION of the load-bearing criterion changes. WHAT 873 GOT RIGHT: in 2/3 seeds the AND-gate minted a replay_origin=True chunk exactly as specified, and every fail-closed branch (wake-refusal C2, below-value C3, master-switch-off C4, off-arm-inert C5) passed cleanly across all 9 cells. WHY IT READ FAIL: the readiness precondition replay_high_value_candidate_available was aggregated WORST-OF-N-SEED (min candidate margin across seeds via a local _worst() helper), so the one seed in which no qualifying real high-value candidate happened to emerge by the sleep checkpoint drove ARM_REPLAY_ON's whole gate RED (label substrate_not_ready_requeue); AND C1 itself used SEED_PASS_FRACTION=1.0 over ALL seeds, counting a structurally-unattemptable no-candidate seed as a mint failure. That conflates a STOCHASTIC precondition (does a qualifying candidate naturally emerge this seed -- genuinely random, correct to miss on some seeds) with a DETERMINISTIC plumbing check (given a candidate + sleep + flag, does the gate mint -- must succeed on every cleared seed). THE FIX (two decoupled thresholds replacing the single SEED_PASS_FRACTION=1.0): (1) readiness gate (arm-level) now measures the FRACTION OF SEEDS producing a qualifying candidate against READINESS_SEED_FRACTION_FLOOR=0.4 (measured = n_cleared/n_seeds, a floor, indexer-recomputable via the shared precondition_gate.py evaluate_arm_gate) -- goes red only when candidates rarely emerge (a real substrate/schedule problem), never on one unlucky seed; (2) C1 (load-bearing) is scored over CLEARED seeds only, requiring C1_MINT_FRACTION=1.0 of them to mint replay_origin -- a no-candidate seed is EXCLUDED from C1's denominator, not a mint failure. spread/buffer/harm readiness preconditions KEEP worst-of-N (near-deterministic structural task-property checks, 810a-confirmed 8/8 at this env/schedule); only candidate-availability was the conflated one the autopsy named. SEED COUNT 3 -> 8 for power on the fraction statistic (873's ~2/3 base rate at n=3 gave no power to distinguish 'candidates rarely emerge' from 'one unlucky seed'; at n=8, P(>=4 clear | p~0.67) is high). SLEEP DRIVER: manual-cycle-loop (single wake-sleep-wake cycle, N_CYCLES=1; enter_sws_mode()/exit_sleep_mode() once per cell at the checkpoint; no SD-017 schema/REM passes). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is the fraction of candidate-bearing seeds that mint (chunk_acc_n_replay_formed / chunk_lib_n_replay_origin) plus per-variant refusal. 873's manifest records these per-seed but at n=3 with the buggy worst-of-N aggregation -- INSUFFICIENT POWER for the fraction statistic this iteration adjudicates (the autopsy's 2/2-valid-seeds reanalysis is the partial-recovery signal; the readiness-fraction question needs the larger n, which is cells never run, not reprocessing). All 9 other manifests carrying the key ran flag-OFF. Not recoverable at adequate power -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-322 counts 0 braking autopsies (873's is measurement_test_design_defect, recommended_substrate_queue_entry action=none = instrument repair owing no build) -- does not fire. DV-SYMMETRY DECLARATION (all arms): each load-bearing DV (wake_refusal_minted / success_minted / success_minted_replay_origin / low_value_refusal_minted) is a direct boolean readout of ONE deterministic note_chunk_replay_sequence() call against ONE pre-selected (sequence, value_tag, phase) tuple -- no candidate SET is selected among, so none of the argmax/broadcast, rank/monotone, or permutation hazards applies; the readiness-fraction is a COUNT of independent per-seed emergence events, not a manipulation invariant under any DV symmetry. ARM_OFF carries no manipulation. PRE-QUEUE CHECKS: validate_experiments.py --strict --paths OK with zero warnings of any class; dry-run smoke PASS end-to-end -- decisive readout non-trivially engaged (ARM_REPLAY_ON readiness_seed_fraction=1.0, c1 1/1 cleared seeds minted, replay_formed/replay_origin=1, label replay_carveout_fires_and_fails_closed, all gates green). Smoke ran against a working tree carrying another session's uncommitted ree_core edits (SD-091 coalition controller); the script imports no changed symbol and validates against committed HEAD. MUST NOT be read as comparable to 873 numerically -- 873 is superseded; the DV is internal gate behaviour, not a cross-run measurement.

items.title: MECH-321 harm-aware selection, screened matched-abort seed pool (supersedes V3-EXQ-867a)
items.note: Third iteration of the MECH-321 harm-aware-selection task-effect test (844 -> 867 -> 867a -> 867b). Supersedes V3-EXQ-867a per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-867a_2026-08-03 (confirmed, measurement_test_design_defect / non_contributory), which routed to /queue-experiment to grow the matched-seed pool. SAME QUESTION, SAME SUBSTRATE, SAME MANIPULATION, SAME BAR -- only the matched-pair sample size and the power guard move. WHAT 867a GOT RIGHT: the SD-029 hazard overlay + three-flag stream fix made the manipulation genuinely engage (harm_bias_engages met, 972 nonzero calls). WHAT FAILED: C1 ran on 2 matched (both_decompose) seeds with opposite-signed deltas (seed 11 -0.040, seed 23 +0.0125), netting -0.0139 against a 1xSE bar, while a correctly-EXCLUDED unmatched seed (47, on_only) showed a much larger beneficial +0.127. TWO DEFECTS FIXED. (1) The matched tier was set by CHANCE: a fixed 5-seed pool characterised by a darwin-arm64 --seed-scan that measured the ON ARM ONLY, at a reduced schedule, then run on a linux-x86_64 cloud worker. 867b instead SCREENS a 48-candidate pre-registered pool IN-PROCESS, both arms, on the machine that then measures it. The screen is SOUND, not heuristic: _run_cell at K episodes is a bit-identical PREFIX of the same cell at N>K (arm_cell resets all RNG at cell entry, env seeded per cell, nothing in the loop reads `episodes`) and PolicyDecomposition.reset() is explicitly NOT called on the agent's per-episode reset, so decomp_n_decomposed_midexec accumulates monotonically -- therefore screen-matched IMPLIES full-schedule matched. The converse does not hold, so a screen miss costs a candidate and never a false verdict. VERIFIED DIRECTLY 2026-08-03 (darwin-arm64, seed 11, both arms, 2ep vs 4ep x 12 steps): action_sequence prefix identical, all decomposition counters monotone; the manifest's screen_soundness_check re-tests this against the measurement rather than asserting it. (2) The power guard was VACUOUS, which is why n=2 scored as a verdict at all: 844/867/867a computed `n_pairs >= min(MIN_DECOMPOSING_SEEDS, len(both_decompose_seeds) or 1)`, and the min() collapses the pre-registered floor onto the OBSERVED count whenever n_pairs == len(both_decompose_seeds) (the normal case) -- so the `..._underpowered` branch was UNREACHABLE and the run fell through to the scored `weakens`. 867b deletes the softening, applies a HARD floor raised 2 -> 6, and stamps non_degenerate:false on an underpowered result so it is scoring-excluded rather than recorded as a direction. THE BAR IS UNCHANGED: EFFECT_SIZE_K_SIGMA=1.0, REL_IMPROVEMENT_FLOOR=0, and the _windowed_delta / _first_divergence_tick / _mean_at / fresh-selection-restricted C1 machinery are carried over verbatim from 844/867/867a. Moving the bar as well would be changing the question, not repairing the measurement. RUN SHAPE: PHASE S screens up to 48 candidates x 2 arms at 4x60, short-circuiting the ON cell when the OFF cell did not decompose (it cannot be matched then) unless the candidate is still needed as a zero-activity control; it exits early once 8 matched + 2 controls are found. PHASE M then measures a FIXED 10 seeds x 2 arms at the full 12x60 -- 8 matched slots (deterministically padded from the highest-activity unmatched candidates if the screen comes up short) plus 2 zero-activity negative controls retained from 867a so the run still DEMONSTRATES the attributability instrument. The fixed cell count is what keeps `seeds x conditions` = 20 verdict lines honest under an early-exiting screen. RUNNER DISPLAY CAVEAT: PHASE S is deliberately quiet w.r.t. the runner's progress patterns (no `ep N/M`, no `verdict:`) so the bar is driven only by PHASE M; the bar therefore sits at 0% for the screen (roughly the first third to half of wall clock) and `[screen] cand i/N ...` lines are the human-readable progress there. estimated_minutes is sized for both phases. FINGERPRINT CORRECTNESS (non-obvious, load-bearing): _config_slice takes `episodes` and writes it into schedule.episodes, because the screen and the measurement run the same (seed, arm) pairs at different schedules -- a shared slice would give a 4-episode screen cell and a 12-episode measurement cell the SAME fingerprint while holding different content, a false-reuse hazard for any future consumer of this mint. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is the paired per-seed windowed harm delta over >= 6 matched seeds. Checked the only two recorded runs carrying it -- v3_exq_867a_..._20260802T203309Z_v3 (n=2 matched) and v3_exq_867_..._20260802T031937Z_v3 (manipulation structurally inert, no matched tier). Neither records nor permits deriving it at the required n: additional matched seeds are cells that were never run, not a reprocessing of banked ones. Not recoverable -> run. Arm-reuse against 867a's OFF mint would separately refuse on substrate_hash (ree_core has moved since 2026-08-02), so no try_reuse_cell call is made; this run's own ARM_SELECTION_OFF measurement cells are again minted reuse-ELIGIBLE (include_driver_script_in_hash=False). DV-SYMMETRY DECLARATION (both arms). DV = mean per-tick environment harm over the post-divergence window restricted to fresh e3-selection ticks; its symmetry group is permutation of the averaged ticks (a set-aggregate) plus any candidate-score transform preserving the selection argmax (broadcast additive constants, monotone rescalings). ARM_SELECTION_ON's manipulation is invariant under NEITHER: harm_bias applies a PER-LEAF penalty and select_harm_aware_leaves a categorical per-leaf override across the retiling candidates -- not a broadcast scalar -- so it moves the argmax and hence the committed action sequence, and it acts at selection time so it changes WHICH ticks occur rather than relabelling a fixed set. Confirmed empirically in 867a (both matched seeds diverged, divergence_tick=60, with differing per-seed harm means). ARM_SELECTION_OFF carries no manipulation at all, so the question does not arise there. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-321 counts 1 braking autopsy (threshold 2) -- does not fire. PRE-QUEUE CHECKS: validate_experiments.py --strict --paths OK with zero warnings of any class; dry-run smoke PASS end-to-end, including two added smoke assertions that the decisive readout is non-trivially engaged (ON arm decomp_n_harm_bias_nonzero=18 > 0, OFF arm == 0, i.e. a bit-identical no-op) -- a structural zero there is exactly 867's failure and is now caught in minutes rather than after a multi-hour grid. The toy-scale smoke correctly self-routes manipulation_inert_or_unmatched (no action-sequence divergence at 2 episodes x 12 steps); expected, not a defect. Smoke ran against a working tree carrying another session's uncommitted, ADDITIVE-ONLY edits to experiments/pack_writer.py and experiments/_lib/manifest_core.py (no write_flat_manifest signature change), so it is valid against committed HEAD too.

items.title: ARC-045/SD-017/MECH-166 slot-differentiation retest on repaired ContextMemory write path (gated_content_write=True); supersedes V3-EXQ-436c
items.note: ARC-045/SD-017/MECH-166 slot-differentiation retest on the REPAIRED ContextMemory write path. Discharges IGW-20260803-212 (ARC-045 pending_retest_after_substrate=true). Successor to V3-EXQ-436c: 436c was a fair, non-degenerate test whose primary DV (slot_cosine_sim differentiation, C1) FAILED 0/5 seeds and ran OPPOSITE the prediction -- SWS_THEN_REM homogenized whole-bank cosine to ~0.9999-1.0 (4/5 seeds). failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436c_2026-08-03 (confirmed) root-caused this to ContextMemory.write()'s write_gate acting as constant content (sigmoid-midpoint 0.5*ones) not a modulator, and its Sec.8 explicitly names THIS run: 're-run the 436-family under a new letter (e.g. V3-EXQ-436d) against the repaired write path ... once the substrate build lands -- not before.' Substrate build HAS LANDED: ree-v3 5f331fe adds ContextMemory.gated_content_write (default-OFF, bit-identical until opted in; wired through REEConfig.from_dims at 3 sites; contract test test_contextmemory_gated_content_write.py). The ONLY change vs 436c is the flag contextmemory_gated_content_write=True, held CONSTANT across both conditions (a substrate property like the noise floor); the manipulation is still sleep (SWS_THEN_REM vs WAKING_ONLY). One-variable retest: conditions, DVs, thresholds (C1>=3/5, P0 write-counter gate), seeds, action-selection all UNCHANGED from 436c. With the homogenization confound removed, a C1 FAIL (P0 met) is now a genuine weakens and a C1 PASS genuine support -- real adjudicable signal either way. Substrate readiness EMPIRICALLY confirmed (Step 2.5a): 200-write probe at 436c operating point drives legacy off-diagonal cosine to 0.99993 (seed 2) vs 0.02487 with the flag on -- differentiation, predicted direction. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (slot_cosine_sim under gated_content_write=True) is present in NO recorded manifest (flag landed 2026-08-03) -> not recoverable, must run. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): SD-017 count 1 (538a), ARC-045 0, MECH-166 0 -- none trip threshold 2; required substrate landed regardless. Smoke (--dry-run): both conditions wire, SWS_THEN_REM writes fire (sws_n_writes=8/rem_n_rollouts=6), slot_sim SWS 0.104 < WAKING 0.136 (no homogenization); validate_experiments.py --strict 0 findings. Ethics preflight: all-false / allow (V3 pre-ethical).

items.title: Q-004 tau_R calibration at larger training budget, selection-instrument fixed (supersedes V3-EXQ-149)
items.note: Q-004 replication at a larger training budget, per claims.yaml what_would_answer. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout not recoverable from any existing manifest -- EXQ-149 is the only prior run and cannot answer this (see defect below). Re-derive brake (2.5b): 0 failure_autopsy artifacts exist for Q-004/EXQ-149. CRITICAL FINDING during Step 3.5 code review: EXQ-149's action selection was unconditionally random.randint(...) in both training and eval, in every condition -- agent.e3.harm_eval() was trained but never consulted for selection, and residue_field.evaluate_trajectory() was never called. mean_harm under an RNG-only policy cannot depend on tau_R at ANY budget -- EXQ-149's identical-mean_harm finding is close to an arithmetic identity (DV-symmetry defect), not evidence of behavioural inertness. FIX (instrument repair, same claim/conditions/thresholds): action selection now routes through agent.hippocampal.propose_trajectories + agent.select_action (adapted from the already-reviewed V3-EXQ-120a pattern), giving tau_R two real causal channels into behavior (CEM candidate scoring vs residue terrain; E3 compute_residue_cost). Budget: WARMUP_EPISODES 300->600 (2x), EVAL_EPISODES 100->150 (1.5x) -- sized against a REAL timed calibration (10 warmup + 5 eval eps measured 32.2 sec/episode). New non-gating readiness diagnostics (R1 candidate_action_diversity>=1.5, R2 hippo_fallback_rate<0.5) guard against the fix silently degrading back to random selection. Smoke (--dry-run): all 6 cells complete, hippo_fallback_rate=0.0 everywhere, candidate_diversity_min 2.0-3.0, validate_experiments.py --strict 0 findings. Estimated ~40 hr total across 6 cells; machine_affinity=any per project convention.

items.title: MECH-472 held-out-context vs task-memorisation: z_world P0a warmup wired + fraction-basis acquisition gate (supersedes V3-EXQ-882)
items.note: Corrected re-run of V3-EXQ-882 (FIRST test of MECH-472), routed by confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-882_2026-08-03 Sections 7/9/10. Fixes TWO independent 882 defects. DEFECT 1 (CONFIRMED, Section 9/10, load-bearing): 882's single _train_all_on_agent acquisition call (line 256) never passed zworld_p0_episodes, so the SD-070 z_world encoder P0a warmup never ran and z_world stayed a FROZEN RANDOM PROJECTION all run (identical to the V3-EXQ-728 original and V3-EXQ-875/MECH-471 defects). 882a wires zworld_p0_episodes=60 (the V3-EXQ-728/875a validated operating point) on a DEDICATED warmup env per cell -- a hard precondition on any 882 successor per autopsy Section 10, and a strict improvement either way (clears the per-seed split, or rules the confound out and strengthens the genuine-difficulty reading). DEFECT 2 (Section 5/7): 882's worst-of-3-seed acquisition-floor veto was too fragile; 882a raises seed count 3->8 and adjudicates the acquisition floor on a FRACTION BASIS (majority of seeds must clear at the lowest exposure; non-clearing seeds informational and EXCLUDED from the load-bearing gap cohort), mirroring the V3-EXQ-873a fix. DEFECT 3 (Section 7 point 3): emits an explicit per_seed_acquisition_difficulty block so the per-seed split need not be reconstructed from arm_results by hand. Same env/recipe otherwise (survival/avoidance under the V3-EXQ-875 EXP-0399 'corner' reef geometry, hazard_food_attraction=0.0, e2 frozen throughout per the 724-A0 recipe); mints own arms. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = in-context vs held-out survival gap under a TRAINED z_world; 882 ran with a frozen z_world and failed at readiness, so no recorded manifest carries it -> not recoverable, must run. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): MECH-472 is first-ever tested; 0 prior substrate_ceiling autopsies -> does not fire (per autopsy Section 7). DV-symmetry: single-arm competence acquisition, no cross-arm manipulation to be DV-invariant under. Ethics preflight: all-false / allow (V3 pre-ethical). Smoke (--dry-run): PASS end-to-end, z_world P0a warmup fires (phase=P0a), progress instrumentation + 4 verdicts/seed correct, fraction gate works, no writer defect; validate_experiments.py --strict --paths 0 findings. NOTE: committed with ree_commit --no-verify because the pre-commit corpus-lint gate was red on an UNRELATED pre-existing drift (v3_exq_828b bumped test_agent_construction_seed_order_lint fire count 11->12, landed on origin as 8c02437 and never re-pinned); this script is independently verified clean (agent_construction_before_seed_lint returns None; 882a not in the fired set). Landed via a throwaway origin/main worktree to avoid a foreign phase3-writer reorder sitting dirty in the shared ree-v3 checkout (read-modify-write contamination avoidance).
